snippet.title: Afterworld: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Afterworld, Dustlanders!

Lead a tribe of survivors in a post-apocalyptic world, rebuilding America by any means necessary. Rediscover old technologies, manage settlements and wage wars of conquest as you make your place in this unforgiving world. Your Empire from the Ashes.

An original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, the creators of Crusader Kings III and Hearts of Iron IV. 

Wishlist the game now on Steam: https://pdxint.at/4qrCxII

Read Dev Diary#1 for more about the game, and the vision behind it: https://pdxint.at/4y1Nt2w
-----------------------------------------------
